## Release — backlog-campaign v0.39.0

### ✨ What's new in v0.39.0

#### Features

- feat(doc-governance): parseable review_trigger grammar with advisory lint ([#1655](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1655))
- feat(reviewer): no-checkout rule for the read-only reviewer ([#1659](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1659))
- feat(decide): ask owner-gated PRs and blocked owner questions beside parked decisions ([#1635](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1635))

#### Fixes

- fix(agents): bring implementer definition under its token ceiling ([#1658](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1658))
- fix(carry): post-merge staged-promotion sweep and package-scoped carry allowlist ([#1660](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1660))
- fix(carry): re-check allowlist on the symlink-resolved target ([#1663](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1663))
- fix(sweep): count an append_row as carried only when its row is in the target ([#1664](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1664))
- fix(docs-lifecycle): doc-health signal reaches a consumer documentation tree ([#1665](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1665))
- fix(stop): release claim labels of issues a stop resets or triages ([#1666](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1666))
- fix(sync): route an issue with an open own PR to review ([#1669](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1669))
